verdict.rationale: HubSpot's docs describe built-in AI agents (Breeze) that can be delegated tasks directly inside the product — a prospecting agent that autonomously reaches out to accounts, deal-progression AI that handles next steps, content-generation for blogs/social/landing pages, and natural-language report building — going beyond a chat helper into task delegation. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of these agents in real use, and detail on autonomy/approval controls beyond marketing copy.
